articles.summary: Technology in service of the investigator. Always. The volume of Child Sexual Abuse Material (CSAM) reaching law enforcement is at a historic high, and it continues to grow. Online platforms, encrypted services and dark web infrastructure have enabled production and storage of CSAM at a scale that was unimaginable a decade ago. For the investigators […]
articles.title: Managing CSAM Investigations at Scale: How AI-Powered Triage Is Transforming Child Protection
